summary: Backend-only follow-up verification of TestFlight Build 119 Bug 15/16 refactor — this iteration eliminates the LAST three direct `expo-speech` runtime call sites so members hear ONE consistent George cloud voice EVERYWHERE (including auto-read paths). STATIC / STRUCTURAL + BACKEND-CONTRACT SCOPE ONLY (physical iPhone AVAudioPlayer runtime must be verified on TestFlight hardware). Results: 27/27 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter90_speech_auto_paths.py. Verified: (1) app/dm/[id].tsx no longer imports expo-speech; imports speakGeorgeAuto+stopGeorgeAuto from @/src/lib/tts-shared; WS onmessage auto-read calls speakGeorgeAuto(String(data.message.text)); useEffect cleanup calls stopGeorgeAuto(); no runtime Speech.* calls remain. (2) app/games/bingo/player.tsx no longer imports expo-speech; imports speakGeorgeAuto+stopGeorgeAuto from tts-shared; callNext() invokes speakGeorgeAuto(`${letterFor(callNum)} ${callNum}`) preceded by stopGeorgeAuto(); callBingo() invokes speakGeorgeAuto('Bingo! Well done!') preceded by stopGeorgeAuto(); no runtime Speech.* calls remain. (3) src/components/george/GeorgeOnboarding.tsx no longer imports expo-speech; unmount cleanup no longer calls Speech.stop(); still uses speakGeorgeAloud/stopGeorgeAutoRead from george-auto-read for cloud auto-read. (4) src/lib/tts-shared.ts exports both speakGeorgeAuto (async) and stopGeorgeAuto; uses dynamic `await import('./george-api')`, `await import('./george-voice')`, `await import('./george-playback')` to break the SpeakButton→tts-shared→george-api cycle; NO top-level static imports of those three modules; catch block is silent and only warns under __DEV__; reuses shared claimActiveSpeaker/releaseActiveSpeaker registry and getCachedUri/setCachedUri URI cache (same singletons as SpeakButton + GeorgeSpeakButton). (5) Repo-wide grep across /app/frontend/{app,src} confirms ZERO non-comment references to `expo-speech`, `Speech.speak(`, or `Speech.stop(` — the 7 remaining hits are all inside doc-comments (app/onboarding.tsx L135, app/settings.tsx L178, GeorgeOnboarding.tsx L209, SpeakButton.tsx L5, george-auto-read.ts L11, tts-shared.ts L77/L108) explaining historical context. (6) Backend regression smoke: /api/voice/transcribe still 422s on missing 'audio' field and 400/422s on empty audio bytes; /api/mcgs/george/speak still auth-gated (401 unauth); no 5xx anywhere. (7) Metro bundle succeeds cleanly: 1569 modules bundled in 1126ms — matches the expected module count in the review request, zero errors.
action_items: DEVICE-TEST REQUIRED (only reproducible on TestFlight hardware, not in web preview): Build a fresh TestFlight bundle for Garry's iPhone and verify the three newly-migrated auto-read paths now play George's cloud voice (OpenAI onyx/nova), NOT Apple's default TTS: (i) In a DM with `Auto-read new messages` toggled ON, receive a message from the other user — the incoming text should be spoken by George. (ii) Start a Bingo game (Hard/Nightmare or manual mode) with `Read messages aloud` ON — each called number ('B 12', 'I 22', …) should be announced by George's voice. (iii) Achieve BINGO — the 'Bingo! Well done!' celebration should also be George's voice. Same first-tap-downloads-then-caches behaviour as SpeakButton (mp3 named `george-<voice>-<hash>.mp3`).

NON-BLOCKING: Two protected comments (app/settings.tsx L178 and app/onboarding.tsx L135) still mention `expo-speech` as historical documentation. Harmless — grep-tested to be inside `/* … */` and `//` comments only. No action required unless doc cleanup is desired.

NON-BLOCKING: The expo-speech npm package can now potentially be removed from package.json since there are zero runtime consumers, but this is a separate housekeeping ticket — verify no lazy `require('expo-speech')` at runtime first (grep is clean, so it's safe to remove).
critical_code_review_comments: tts-shared.ts speakGeorgeAuto(): dynamic imports of ./george-api, ./george-voice, ./george-playback correctly break the circular dep that would exist if SpeakButton (which imports tts-shared eagerly) transitively pulled georgeApi at module-load time. Small runtime cost (one microtask per first call) is negligible vs. the network fetch that follows.

tts-shared.ts speakGeorgeAuto() reuses claimActiveSpeaker so a bingo callout on 'I 22' correctly stops the previous 'B 15' still playing — no overlapping voices. Also stops any SpeakButton/GeorgeSpeakButton currently active, which is exactly the desired 'one voice at a time' UX.

dm/[id].tsx cleanup: `return () => { ws.close(); stopGeorgeAuto(); }` is idempotent — safe to call even when nothing is playing. Also correctly runs when the user navigates away mid-utterance so the DM voice doesn't linger on the next screen.

bingo/player.tsx: both callNext() and callBingo() call stopGeorgeAuto() BEFORE the new speakGeorgeAuto — good, because auto-call Hard/Nightmare mode fires callNext() on an interval and back-to-back callouts must interrupt cleanly.
GeorgeOnboarding.tsx: the dead `Speech.stop()` unmount cleanup has been removed. The remaining `stopGeorgeAutoRead()` cleanup already covers the cloud auto-read pathway, so no functionality lost.

Repo-wide sanity confirmed: 100% of remaining 'expo-speech'/'Speech.speak'/'Speech.stop' textual hits are inside single-line // or block /* */ comments. Verified programmatically in TestRepoWideSpeechSanity (3 tests) by parsing each hit's line context.

This iteration removes the LAST three direct `expo-speech` runtime call sites so members hear ONE consistent George cloud voice EVERYWHERE — including the three auto-read paths that iter89 explicitly flagged as out-of-scope (DM WS auto-read, bingo number call-outs, bingo win celebration). rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration is a proactive follow-up to close the gap iter89 explicitly documented: the SpeakButton refactor (iter89) only covered tap-to-read speaker buttons, leaving three auto-triggered call sites (dm/[id].tsx L49 auto-read of incoming DM, bingo/player.tsx L74 number call-out, bingo/player.tsx L100 'Bingo! Well done!') still using Apple's `Speech.speak(...)`. The main agent's fix introduces a shared fire-and-forget helper `speakGeorgeAuto(text)` in tts-shared.ts that (a) reuses the exact same active-speaker registry + URI cache as SpeakButton/GeorgeSpeakButton (so only ONE voice plays app-wide at any moment, and repeat text hits the cache), (b) uses dynamic imports of ./george-api, ./george-voice, ./george-playback to sidestep the circular dep that would otherwise form (SpeakButton → tts-shared → george-api → …), and (c) silently swallows errors (with a __DEV__-only console.warn) so background auto-read never disrupts the UX — mirroring the intent of the `Speech.speak` calls it replaces. Structurally verified end-to-end; ships-to-hardware validation is Garry's next step.
